name: Guardian Portrait

source.note: Curse of Strahd appendix block (2016) in the 2024 layout. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Its spells and their uses, its languages and any other traits need the book. It has no attacks: in a fight it only casts, and the AI doesn't pick these four spells yet, so it waits (text only for now).

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.summary: Looks like an ordinary painting while the figure in it stays still.
traits.text: As long as the figure in the frame doesn't move, nothing marks it out from a normal painting.

actions.name: Innate Spellcasting
actions.summary: Int, DC 12, no material components: Counterspell, Crown of Madness, Hypnotic Pattern and Telekinesis, 3 times a day each.
actions.text: The portrait casts spells using Intelligence (spell save DC 12), needing no material components. 3/day each: Counterspell, Crown of Madness, Hypnotic Pattern, Telekinesis.

summary: A painted guardian whose eyes follow you: it can't move or strike, but it bewitches and hurls intruders with magic.
